rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because both proclamations quote a statute that makes presidential proclamation contingent on a prior determination or recommendation by a designated body, then use a short operative clause to proclaim that the specified articles or drug fall within the statutory classification. C01 has a related recommendation-to-proclamation sequence but uses the materially different machinery of establishing a land preserve. C05 shares the statute-recital and find-and-proclaim form, but its operative mechanism is an extension of filing time rather than presidential confirmation of an antecedent agency classification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: ... [a drug] found by the Secretary of the Treasury ... and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 12(i) of the joint resolution of Congress ... provides in part as follows: The President is hereby authorized to proclaim upon recommendation of the ... Board ... a list of articles which shall be considered arms, ammunition, and implements of war
shared_material.explanation: Each opens by quoting the precise statutory machinery under which a designated body supplies the predicate and the President formalizes a classification by proclamation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury ... has found the drug Isoamidone ... to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine
shared_material.parent_excerpt: pursuant to the recommendation of the national Munitions Control Board
shared_material.explanation: Both recite that the required antecedent agency action has occurred before the President acts.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found the drug Isoamidone ... to have an addiction-forming and addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine
shared_material.parent_excerpt: hereby declare and proclaim that the articles listed below shall ... be considered arms, ammunition, and implements of war for the purposes of section 12
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions use the presidential proclamation to place specified material within a statutory regulatory category.
